title: 第19章 陆梦馨出发边境第20章 林浩然来自父亲的爱
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: “那你们便下去召集族人吧，至于选谁去，你们自己决定。”
“是，大哥族长！”
林天羽三人对着林天海拱了拱手，便离开了大殿，挑选族人去了。
在林天海这边就秘境之事商议安排时，另一边刚出关的林轩，便率先来到了凤清殿准备给他娘陆梦馨请安。
“孩儿林轩，给娘请安！”
林轩来到殿内，看着端坐着正和侍女聊天的美丽妇人，恭敬行礼道。
“轩儿出关了？来，快来娘这边，陪娘说说话，都一个月没看到我儿子了。”
只见原本正和侍女聊天的美丽妇人，听到声音，立马转头看去，看到林轩后，连忙高兴的起身来到林轩身前，将他拉了过去，让林轩坐在了她旁边，便开始了嘘寒问暖起来。
而林轩也是笑着不断回应着，没有丝毫不耐烦。
母亲这一角色便这样……虽然唠叨，但这何尝不是在关心你！爱护你！
而同时林轩也在用系统的能力，查看起了他娘陆梦馨的修炼情况。
毕竟这可是他的亲生父母，他自然得对他们上心点，他可不想有一天只剩他独自一人与大道相伴。
他要他的父母、亲人、族人，和他一起证道长生！
以往没获得系统时，他根本不敢想这些事，但如今他有了系统这个挂，一切皆有可能！
【姓名：陆梦馨】
【身份：林家主母、宿主母亲】
【修为：圣人境九重天】
【体质：幻梦宝体】
【资质：上品】
【悟性：上品】
【对家族忠诚度：100（注：对家族忠诚度最高100）】
【机缘：宿主便是陆梦馨最大的机缘！】
“圣人境九重天？我记得娘一个月前还只是圣人境六重天的……”
看到这里林轩也是为他娘感到高兴。
境界越高修为提升越困难，他娘能一个月从圣人境七重天提升到九重天，已经非常不错了，而且这都多亏了她平时积累雄厚和鸿蒙神树的功劳，不然别说这一个月提升两个小境界了，提升一个小境界都难。
普通修士，圣人境之上每提升一个小境界所花的时间，至少都是数十年起步的，一个月……简直异想天开。（开挂的除外^ω^）
而陆梦馨也好林家其他族人也好，之所以能修炼的如此之快，不仅是因为鸿蒙神树对修炼速度的提升，更是因为它对悟性的提升，让他们能快速悟道，这才能突破的如此之快。
毕竟修炼越到后期，越看重感悟！
content_en:
"Then you go down and gather the clan members. As for who to choose, you decide for yourself."
"Yes, elder brother, patriarch!"
Lin Tianyu and the others bowed their hands to Lin Tianhai, then left the hall to choose their tribe members.
…
While Lin Tianhai was discussing arrangements for the secret realm, Lin Xuan, who had just come out of seclusion, took the lead in arriving at Fengqing Hall to pay his respects to his mother, Lu Mengxin.
"My dear Lin Xuan, please say hello to my mother!"
Lin Xuan came to the palace, looked at the beautiful woman sitting upright and chatting with the maid, and saluted respectfully.
"Xuan'er is out of seclusion? Come on, come to my mother's side and let me talk to you. I haven't seen my son in a month."
The beautiful woman who was chatting with the maid heard the voice and immediately turned her head to look. After seeing Lin Xuan, she quickly stood up happily and came to Lin Xuan, pulled him over, let Lin Xuan sit next to her, and began to greet her.
And Lin Xuan kept responding with a smile, without any impatience.
The role of mother is like this... Although she is nagging, she is not caring about you! Love you!
At the same time, Lin Xuan was also using the system's ability to check the cultivation status of his mother, Lu Mengxin.
After all, these are his biological parents, so he naturally has to pay attention to them. He doesn't want to be left alone with Dao one day.
He wants his parents, relatives, and tribesmen to join him in attaining enlightenment and immortality!
In the past, when he didn't have the system, he didn't dare to think about these things, but now that he has the system, everything is possible!
…
[Name: Lu Mengxin]
[Identity: Lin family mistress, host mother]
【Age: 256】
[Cultivation: Saint Realm Ninth Level]
[Physique: Fantasy Treasure Body]
[Qualification: Top grade]
[Comprehension: Top Grade]
[Loyalty to the family: 100 (Note: Loyalty to the family reaches a maximum of 100)]
[Opportunity: The host is Lu Mengxin’s biggest opportunity! 】
"The ninth level of the saint realm? I remember that my mother was only in the sixth level of the saint realm a month ago..."
Seeing this, Lin Xuan was also happy for his mother.
The higher the realm, the more difficult it is to improve one's cultivation level. It is already very good that his mother can be promoted from the seventh heaven of the saint realm to the ninth heaven in one month, and this is all thanks to her daily accumulation and the credit of the Hongmeng Divine Tree. Otherwise, it would be difficult to improve even one small realm, let alone two small realms in this month.
For ordinary monks, the time it takes to advance to a small realm above the saint realm is at least several decades. A month... is simply unimaginable. (Except those who cheat^ω^)
The reason why Lu Mengxin and other members of the Lin family can practice so fast is not only because the Hongmeng Sacred Tree improves the speed of practice, but also because it improves their understanding, allowing them to quickly realize the Tao, which is why they can break through so quickly.
After all, the more advanced you are in your cultivation, the more emphasis you place on enlightenment!
